headline: Markets closed for weekend; crude oil prices, West Asia flare-up, and strong IPO pipeline in focus

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

why: Stock markets are closed today owing to the weekend and will reopen on Monday, September 21.
Crude oil price trends and West Asia geopolitics are key drivers for market direction in the upcoming week.
Brisk primary market activity continues with multiple IPOs lined up to raise capital.
Investors are closely watching Foreign Institutional Investor (FII) activity and global market cues.
whatHappening: A total of 19 IPO issues are scheduled to open for subscription this week, including 6 major companies raising ₹3,825 crore.
NMDC Chairman announced that the PSU miner is aiming to achieve a 60 MT iron ore production target this fiscal year.
Several corporate actions are scheduled this week for Dixon Tech, BEML, Titagarh Rail Systems, and Bajaj Holdings.
A 3-year test shows Nifty and Sensex trailing fixed deposit returns over the period.
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, September 21. Market focus for the coming week will be guided by crude oil dynamics, geopolitical tensions in West Asia, and a busy primary market with 19 IPO issues. Individual stocks like NMDC, Dixon Tech, and Titagarh Rail Systems will remain in focus for corporate actions and production targets.
